summary: DynaResource filed an 8-K disclosing a private placement of units to fund operations. On September 1, 2026, the company sold 6,666,666 units at $0.45 per unit, raising $3 million, to Golden Post Rail, Ocean Partners UK, Gareth Nichol, and others. Each unit comprised one share of common stock and a warrant to purchase one share at $0.51. Warrant exercise requires stockholder approval and a charter amendment to increase authorized shares or effect a reverse stock split, with voting agreements from certain purchasers. The transaction is effectively a capital raise with dilutive warrants, not a return of capital or other special situation. Watch for shareholder approval of the amendment and potential dilution overhang.
